title: A fund gone cold after four real exchanges

objects.subject: Larkspur x Nimbus Labs
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Loved the demo. How many design partners do you have live today?

Ira
Larkspur Ventures

questions.text: How many design partners are live

inferences.claim: Larkspur looked in earnest: a question after the demo, a quick answer, and the company taken to its Monday meeting within days.
What that meeting decided never reached this file: the last word in it is Arjun's offer to join.
The file has gone cold, not closed: it holds no decline, only a long silence after a warm exchange.
Filed as a sales opportunity, a fund that loved the demo sits outside the seed round's work, where it belongs.
